title: Obtaining Isolation Profile Details Using API

blocks.text: This article provides information for managing Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) isolation profiles using APIs. All APIs are rate limited. To learn more, see Understanding Rate Limiting.

blocks.heading: Getting Details of All Isolation Profiles

blocks.text: To get details of all isolation profiles for a specific customer:

blocks.item: Send a GET request to the following endpoint in the isolation-profile-controller: /mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/{customerId}/isolation/profiles.
Provide the customerId, the ZPA tenant ID of the customer, in the request endpoint. For example: /mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/73189906330943488/isolation/profiles.

A successful response returns code 200. To learn more, see API Response Codes and Error Messages.
This API supports pagination. To get a paginated response:

blocks.item: Send a GET request to the following endpoint in the isolation-profile-controller: /mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/{customerId}/isolation/profiles?page=1&pagesize=20.
Provide the following in the request endpoint:
customerId: the ZPA tenant ID of the customer, in the request endpoint.
Valid values for page and page size parameters.

If not provided, the default page size is 20. The maximum page size is 500.
A successful response returns code 200. To learn more, see API Response Codes and Error Messages.
